about: The law of drawing of the shared unit and everything hidden beside it: ranges, shapes, draw profiles, the thermal model (form and constants), the reply-noise law, the hold-scatter law, the cell's ranges, the mounted-item catalogue, the recorder profiles. HIDDEN: never shipped to an agent; read only through openarm_unit.docs and the hidden modules.
